In Cyr'ethael, she helps the Nefaric Veil turn tribute, fear, protection rackets, and luxury theft into a polished business model, preferring clean profit over messy slaughter. Piera Wrightquill is a relentless lunar elf reporter with a talent for turning rumor, ledgers, overheard threats, and inconvenient witnesses into public scandal. Her moonlit elven instincts make her curious, adaptable, and difficult to intimidate, while Sigrananna’s influence gives her a sharp hunter’s patience when stalking a corrupt official through paper trails instead of forests.
In Cyr'ethael, a town in dragon-ruled Iazethas, Piera’s broadsheets regularly challenge draconic law, civic silence, price-fixing, poisoned canals, militia corruption, and anyone powerful enough to think truth should stay buried. She is sarcastic, lonely, brave to the point of recklessness, and deeply protective of her household, using the Public Broadsheet Office and the Brass Concordat to expose rot before it becomes accepted law.

npcRoster.publicDescription: Irma Velvetglass is a Celestial Elf memory-den host who dresses grief in velvet, candlelight, perfume, and plausible deniability. She offers curated recollection rituals, dream seats, old love reenactments, and supervised ichor-adjacent memory treatments to people who can pay or who are broken enough that someone else pays for them. Irma is theatrical, warm, and business-minded, but she knows nostalgia becomes a narcotic when the present hurts too much to inhabit.

npcRoster.name: Barney Rook
npcRoster.publicDescription: Barney Rook is a cranky Hederan retired marksman who has turned the Pokbith Archive into a half-library, half-firing nest, and he insists both functions are equally educational. Age has not softened his eye or his temper; he still names favored weapons, lectures strangers about sightlines, and treats every broken turret like a neglected old soldier. The Brass Concordat keeps him close because he knows how old defenses fail, how monsters breach them, and which official records lied about both.

Wilderness-bound survivalists adapted to harsh biomes through ritualized instinct and ancestral knowledge. They thrive in isolation but maintain strong clan bonds. Table cues: Darkvision, Outdoor Adept, Protected by Nature, Friend of Fauna; starting tendency Neutral - Chaotic - Neutral - Honorable.

npcRoster.name: Captain Kellis Vorn
npcRoster.publicDescription:
Captain Kellis Vorn is a severe, disciplined Noitzideq Dragonborn skyship captain who believes order is not a preference but the only thing keeping dangerous relics, ichor-fueled engines, and foolish recruits from burning half the province out of the sky. Shaped by Valkhamesh’s draconic inheritance and Iazethas’ harsh culture of law, sovereignty, and military duty, he respects chain of command, clean logistics, decisive elimination of threats, and officers who prove themselves through results rather than speeches.
At the Streccea Guild Desk, Kellis commands Crucible Custodian air operations: skyship patrols, relic-retrieval drops, squire training flights, contraband sweeps, and high-risk strikes against factions trafficking unstable ichor technology. He is loyal to Maxton Vale’s larger mission, but not blindly sentimental about it; if an asset, ally, or escaped experiment threatens civilian safety or Custodian secrecy, Kellis will mark the target and expect the job done cleanly.

areaModel.method: Earth-sized spherical Voronoi province territory model
areaModel.reason: The province JSON files contain locked province center latitude/longitude coordinates, but no hand-drawn province border polygons. This model assigns every point on Belavadös to the nearest province center on an Earth-sized sphere, producing non-overlapping province territories whose areas sum exactly to the full planetary surface area in this model.
areaModel.boundaryNote: Boundary vertices are generated model borders between province centers, not hand-surveyed coastline or political-border artwork.
areaModel.precisionNote: Areas are model-exact for the spherical Voronoi territory model and rounded to 6 decimal places in output.
